description: This file provides utility functions for user authentication in a React frontend, leveraging Supabase services for sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth, sign-out, password update, and error handling.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional metadata, setting a fixed email confirmation redirect URL.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user using email and password credentials.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a fixed redirect URL for password reset page.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in a user via a magic link (OTP) with a fixed email redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Signs in using an OAuth provider (e.g., Google, GitHub) with redirect URL fixed to the login page.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors by displaying user-friendly messages and redirecting using the router.
